item.title: Mechanistic Insights of Jahn–Teller Effect Suppression in High-Entropy Prussian Blue Analogue Cathodes
item.description:

Journal of the American Chemical Society | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in revealing that high-entropy design suppresses Jahn–Teller distortion not by eliminating it but by randomizing distortion orientations and reducing orbital energy splitting, disrupting long-range cooperative order. Its significance is demonstrating a mechanistic strategy enabling ultrastable Mn-based cathodes, with 91.0% retention over 50,000 cycles, surpassing all Mn-based rechargeable batteries.
🏷 Prussian blue analogue · high-entropy cathode · Jahn-Teller effect · machine learning potential · EXAFS
